title: Default On
tags: 1970s jazz-folk, relaxed swung shuffle with a half-time bluesy verse; warm analog tape in a slightly tinny mono mix; small jazz combo led by flute, Fender Rhodes and upright piano, walking upright bass, brushed drums, muted trumpet fills and scat; raspy conversational male vocal with a young character tone, crooning legato phrasing doubled on the hooks, spoken asides over a vamp and a sing-along teaching chorus.
